scientific_integrity: Proof by Gaussian polar coordinates and exact two-node Lanczos identity; supporting seeded verifier with 1694 checks, no external audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for real Gaussian P-SLQ on a two-dimensional positive-definite complement and a fixed even projected-matvec budget; excludes setup and projector overhead, adaptive stopping, other loss functions, arbitrary spectra, and rounding effects. Classical SLQ and Gaussian identities are not claimed new; specialized historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Exact probe-depth allocation frontier for two-mode projected Gaussian Lanczos quadrature
